description: List the sections of a course, returning each section's id, name, course_id, start_at, end_at and restrict_enrollments_to_section_dates. Use it to resolve the section ID that `create_assignment_override` needs for a section-specific due date, that `enroll_user` takes as `course_section_id`, and that the `needs_grading_count_by_section` option on `list_assignments` reports against; use `list_course_enrollments` or `list_course_users` for the people in a section rather than the sections themselves, or `get_course` with include: ['sections'] when you also need other course fields in the same call. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. This tool never requests Canvas's student roster include, so no student names are returned. The SIS fields (sis_section_id, sis_course_id, integration_id) appear only for callers with SIS read permission, and Canvas silently drops the total_students and permissions extras — rather than erroring — unless the caller can read the course roster or grades. search_term must be at least 2 characters; Canvas ignores shorter ones. Requires read access to the course.

include.description: Extra fields to include on each section (Canvas include[] param)

search_term.description: Return only sections whose name matches this term (at least 2 characters)

name: list_sections
title: List Course Sections
